skills.description: Daily Hyperliquid account brief, read through the hyperliquid CLI, for the address in var: default-dex equity, withdrawable and margin use (for unified and portfolio-margin accounts the spot USDC balance and margin used instead), per-position PnL and liquidation price across dexes, open orders, and 24h realized PnL and fees by token.
